purpose: Closing prices as they actually traded on the last session before a stock split, each published by a source other than Yahoo Finance. bronze_prices must reproduce every one within one cent (tests/test_known_closes.py). Yahoo restates these sessions after each split, so matching them proves the stored history is in traded terms, not restated terms.
rules: Each row cites a page that states the figure in prose or in a table; the quote is verbatim from the fetched page.
No source is Yahoo Finance or a chart site that serves split-adjusted history.
No held symbol appears here (this file is tracked).
